data.exact_reserve_text: An overall deterioration of GBP 0.1 million on prior years' provisions was experienced during the year. This is due to deteriorations of GBP 0.4 million on casualty reinsurance and GBP 0.2 million on marine reinsurance partially offset by an improvement of GBP 0.5 million on property reinsurance. (2019: An overall deterioration of GBP 3.0 million on prior years' provisions was experienced during the year. This is due to deteriorations of GBP 2.0 million on casualty reinsurance and GBP 1.0 million on property reinsurance.)

named_events.loss_description: COVID-19 related net losses GBP 15.7 million
The largest natural catastrophe loss incurred by the syndicate was in respect of Hurricane Laura.
Continuation of major bushfires affecting Australia which started in 2019 but continued into 2020.
Devastating tornadoes affecting the state of Tennessee.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a small overall deterioration in prior years' claims provisions of GBP 0.1m in 2020. This movement arose from adverse development in casualty (strengthening by GBP 0.4m) and marine (strengthening by GBP 0.2m) lines, partially offset by a favourable development in property (release of GBP 0.5m). The net prior year movement is therefore a modest strengthening, with the main impacts coming from casualty and marine portfolios.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Statement of Financial Position (gross claims outstanding prior year column). Prior year development taken from the 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' narrative note (gross amounts given as narrative).
